title: A Cipher for the Autopsy
author: Ulyana Dunmore
blurb: Sable Okafor, a retired detective running a failing bookshop, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then a confession letter arrives postmarked the day after the funeral — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
